    Finite chains of subspaces and basis flags #

    This file proves the linear-algebraic bridge from a finite chain of subspaces to a complete basis flag containing that chain.

    source
    theorem MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.finrank_flag {k : Type u} [Field k] {V : Type u} [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] {n : ℕ} (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) k V) (m : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Module.finrank k ↥(b.flag m) = ↑m

    The m-th subspace in a basis flag has dimension m.

      theorem MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.exists_flag_basis_of_finset_chain {k : Type u} [Field k] {V : Type u} [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [FiniteDimensional k V] (C : Finset (Submodule k V)) (hC : IsChain (fun (x1 x2 : Submodule k V) => x1 ≤ x2) ↑C) :
      ∃ (b : Module.Basis (Fin (Module.finrank k V)) k V), ∀ U ∈ C, ∃ (m : Fin (Module.finrank k V + 1)), U = b.flag m
